HegemonMod:ExampleCard.NAME: Name
HegemonMod:ExampleCard.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: This will automatically be used if the card is upgraded. Remove it if unneeded.
EXTENDED_DESCRIPTION: You can put more text in here.
If you need to use it for stuff.
Blizzard is a good example for this.

HegemonMod:Crunch.NAME: Crunch
HegemonMod:Crunch.DESCRIPTION: Deal damage equal to HegemonMod:Toxicity gained this turn X !M!. NL (!D!)

HegemonMod:HeroicPlay.NAME: Heroic Play
HegemonMod:HeroicPlay.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Become Frail and Vulnerable.

HegemonMod:LashOut.NAME: Lash Out
HegemonMod:LashOut.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! HegemonMod:Necrotic damage. NL Inflict !M! HegemonMod:Leech_Toxin.

HegemonMod:ToxicStrike.NAME: Toxic Strike
HegemonMod:ToxicStrike.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. Gain !M! HegemonMod:Toxicity and 1 Weak.

HegemonMod:BurnOut.NAME: Burn Out
HegemonMod:BurnOut.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! HegemonMod:Necrotic damage to ALL enemies. NL Gain !M! less [E] next turn.

HegemonMod:Exert.NAME: Exert
HegemonMod:Exert.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Draw !M! less next turn.

HegemonMod:Flail.NAME: Flail
HegemonMod:Flail.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage to a random enemy !M! times. Make a *Punition in your draw pile and draw 1.

HegemonMod:PunishFlurry.NAME: Punish Flurry
HegemonMod:PunishFlurry.DESCRIPTION: Apply !M! HegemonMod:Sin then deal !D! HegemonMod:Necrotic damage to ALL enemies.

HegemonMod:WayOfTheReaper.NAME: Way of the Reaper
HegemonMod:WayOfTheReaper.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! HegemonMod:Necrotic damage and gain a random *Form *of *the *Reaper. NL Exhaust.
HegemonMod:WayOfTheReaper.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! HegemonMod:Necrotic damage and gain a random *Form *of *the *Reaper.

HegemonMod:Punish.NAME: Punish
HegemonMod:Punish.DESCRIPTION: Retain. NL Apply !M! HegemonMod:Sin. NL Deal !D! HegemonMod:Necrotic damage. NL Exhaust.

HegemonMod:Punition.NAME: Punition
HegemonMod:Punition.DESCRIPTION: Retain. NL Apply !M! HegemonMod:Sin. NL Deal !D! HegemonMod:Necrotic damage. NL Exhaust.

HegemonMod:CloakofNight.NAME: Cloak of Night
HegemonMod:CloakofNight.DESCRIPTION: Gain !B! Block. NL Gain 1 Dexterity and 1 Frail.

HegemonMod:IncreaseToxicity.NAME: Intoxicate
HegemonMod:IncreaseToxicity.DESCRIPTION: Gain 2 HegemonMod:Toxicity, 1 Weak and draw !M!. NL Exhaust. NL Can be Upgraded any number of times.

HegemonMod:Recover.NAME: Recover
HegemonMod:Recover.DESCRIPTION: Gain !HegemonMod:Artifact! Artifact. Target monster heals by 3 each turn. NL Exhaust.
HegemonMod:Recover.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Gain !HegemonMod:Artifact! Artifact. Target monster heals by 3 each turn.

HegemonMod:SkillBookVanilla.NAME: Vanilla Skill Book
HegemonMod:SkillBookVanilla.DESCRIPTION: Create a random common skill in your hand. NL Exhaust.
HegemonMod:SkillBookVanilla.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Create a random upgraded common skill in your hand. NL Exhaust.

HegemonMod:SkillBookBlack.NAME: Black Skill Book
HegemonMod:SkillBookBlack.DESCRIPTION: Create a random common Hegemon skill in your hand. NL Exhaust.
HegemonMod:SkillBookBlack.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Create a random upgraded common Hegemon skill in your hand. NL Exhaust.

HegemonMod:SkillBookMods.NAME: Modded Skill Book
HegemonMod:SkillBookMods.DESCRIPTION: Create a random common Modded skill in your hand. NL Exhaust.
HegemonMod:SkillBookMods.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Create a random upgraded common Modded skill in your hand. NL Exhaust.

HegemonMod:PathOfShadows.NAME: Path of Shadows
HegemonMod:PathOfShadows.DESCRIPTION: Gain !B! x !M! Block. NL You cannot gain Block from cards this turn. Block is not removed at the start of your next turn.

HegemonMod:SkillBookColorless.NAME: Colorless Skill Book
HegemonMod:SkillBookColorless.DESCRIPTION: Create a random uncommon colorless skill in your hand. NL Exhaust.
HegemonMod:SkillBookColorless.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Create a random upgraded uncommon colorless skill in your hand. NL Exhaust.

HegemonMod:Unflex.NAME: Un-flex
HegemonMod:Unflex.DESCRIPTION: Gain !M! HegemonMod:Toxicity and 1 Weak. NL Lose !M! Strength at the end of your turn.

HegemonMod:Vaccinate.NAME: Health Potion
HegemonMod:Vaccinate.DESCRIPTION: Ethereal. NL Heal 4. Gain 1 HegemonMod:Leech_Toxin !M! times.

HegemonMod:Cleanse.NAME: Cleanse
HegemonMod:Cleanse.DESCRIPTION: Heal !M!. NL Lose 2 HegemonMod:Toxicity. NL Exhaust.

HegemonMod:FastLearner.NAME: Fast Learner
HegemonMod:FastLearner.DESCRIPTION: Unplayable. NL Retains for !HegemonMod:Retain! turns. NL Cards created with this in hand cost 1 less. NL (!M! left)

HegemonMod:HardLearner.NAME: Hard Learner
HegemonMod:HardLearner.DESCRIPTION: Unplayable. NL Retains for !HegemonMod:Retain! turns. NL Upgrade cards created with this in hand. NL (!M! left)

HegemonMod:Vector.NAME: Vector
HegemonMod:Vector.DESCRIPTION: Apply !M! HegemonMod:Leech_Toxin and heal target by 1. NL Draw 1 card. NL Exhaust.

HegemonMod:GentleTouch.NAME: Gentle Touch
HegemonMod:GentleTouch.DESCRIPTION: Gain !M! Strength and heal targets by !M! on hit.

HegemonMod:LifeSurplus.NAME: Life Surplus
HegemonMod:LifeSurplus.DESCRIPTION: Ethereal. NL At the end of combat, heal up to !M! of your temp HP. NL Gain !HegemonMod:HP! temp HP.

HegemonMod:LikeBlood.NAME: Like Blood
HegemonMod:LikeBlood.DESCRIPTION: At the end of your turn, if you have Artifact, gain !M! Block.

HegemonMod:Meditation.NAME: Meditation
HegemonMod:Meditation.DESCRIPTION: At the start of each turn, gain Weak and draw a card.

HegemonMod:SinEater.NAME: Sin Eater
HegemonMod:SinEater.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you would lose Artifact, gain !M! temporary HP.

HegemonMod:Undeath.NAME: Undeath
HegemonMod:Undeath.DESCRIPTION: At the end of your turn, gain 1 Artifact and lose !M! HP.

HegemonMod:WayOfTheSnake.NAME: Way of the Sage
HegemonMod:WayOfTheSnake.DESCRIPTION: Start each turn with a *Punish in hand.
HegemonMod:WayOfTheSnake.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Innate. NL Start each turn with a *Punish in hand.

HegemonMod:WayOfTheHierophant.NAME: Way of the Hierophant
HegemonMod:WayOfTheHierophant.DESCRIPTION: Start each turn with a *Punition in hand.
HegemonMod:WayOfTheHierophant.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Innate. NL Start each turn with a *Punition in hand.

HegemonMod:PhoenixForm.NAME: Phoenix Form
HegemonMod:PhoenixForm.DESCRIPTION: Ethereal. NL Increase your buffs by an amount that increases each turn. Start each turn with less [E].
HegemonMod:PhoenixForm.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Innate. NL Ethereal. NL Increase your buffs by an amount that increases each turn. Start each turn with less [E].

HegemonMod:PlagueBearer.NAME: Way of the Trickster
HegemonMod:PlagueBearer.DESCRIPTION: After each turn, shuffle a *Vector into the draw pile.
HegemonMod:PlagueBearer.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: After each turn, shuffle !M! *Vectors into the draw pile.

HegemonMod:Sacrifice.NAME: Ritual Sacrifice
HegemonMod:Sacrifice.DESCRIPTION: Can only be played if you have no Artifact. NL !M! Strength. You can no longer heal.
HegemonMod:Sacrifice.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Can only be played if you have no Artifact. NL !M! Strength and 1 Ritual. You can no longer heal.

HegemonMod:WayOfTheHermit.NAME: Way of the Hermit
HegemonMod:WayOfTheHermit.DESCRIPTION: Playing an attack gains you 1 Vulnerable and !M! Block.

HegemonMod:WayOfTheHunter.NAME: Way of the Hunter
HegemonMod:WayOfTheHunter.DESCRIPTION: At the start of each turn, gain 1 Weak and 2 HegemonMod:Toxicity.

HegemonMod:Penitent.NAME: Penitent
HegemonMod:Penitent.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! x !M! damage. NL Gain and apply 1 Strength.

HegemonMod:HydraFlail.NAME: Hydra Flail
HegemonMod:HydraFlail.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage to a random enemy NL 2X times.

HegemonMod:Deliverance.NAME: Deliverance
HegemonMod:Deliverance.DESCRIPTION: Retain. NL Deal !D! damage, !M! HegemonMod:Necrotic damage and apply !HegemonMod:Sin! HegemonMod:Sin. Increase both by !HegemonMod:Increase! on retain.

HegemonMod:Feint.NAME: Feint
HegemonMod:Feint.DESCRIPTION: Gain !B! Block. NL If the target is attacking, apply !M! HegemonMod:Sin.

HegemonMod:FeastofAbsolution.NAME: Absolution
HegemonMod:FeastofAbsolution.DESCRIPTION: Draw !M! and gain [E]. NL Cleanse all of the target's debuffs. NL Exhaust.
HegemonMod:FeastofAbsolution.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Draw !M!. Cleanse all of the target's debuffs and heal the half the amount. NL Exhaust.

HegemonMod:HegemonsMercy.NAME: Hegemon's Mercy
HegemonMod:HegemonsMercy.DESCRIPTION: Cleanse all of the target's debuffs and reduce their strength by the same amount. NL Only half is permanent. NL Exhaust.

HegemonMod:Riposte.NAME: Riposte
HegemonMod:Riposte.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL If the target is attacking, create 2 *Punish
HegemonMod:Riposte.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL If the target is attacking, create 2 *Punish+

HegemonMod:HegemonyCard.NAME: Hegemony
HegemonMod:HegemonyCard.DESCRIPTION: Ethereal. NL Whenever you are attacked, apply !M! HegemonMod:Sin back.
HegemonMod:HegemonyCard.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Innate. NL Ethereal. NL Whenever you are attacked, apply !M! HegemonMod:Sin back.

HegemonMod:DarkGuardian.NAME: Dark Guardian
HegemonMod:DarkGuardian.DESCRIPTION: Ethereal. NL Whenever you would lose Artifact, gain !M! Regen.
HegemonMod:DarkGuardian.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Innate. NL Ethereal. NL Whenever you would lose Artifact, gain !M! Regen.

HegemonMod:RelentlessStudy.NAME: Relentless Study
HegemonMod:RelentlessStudy.DESCRIPTION: Create !M! random single-use uncommon skill in your hand each turn.

HegemonMod:LeechBite.NAME: Leech Bite
HegemonMod:LeechBite.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Inflict HegemonMod:Bleeding and HegemonMod:Leech_Toxin.

HegemonMod:LeechHose.NAME: Leech Hose
HegemonMod:LeechHose.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D!X damage to ALL enemies and apply X Vulnerable and 2X HegemonMod:Leech_Toxin.
HegemonMod:LeechHose.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Deal !D!X damage to ALL enemies and apply X Vulnerable and 3X HegemonMod:Leech_Toxin.

HegemonMod:StoriedDagger.NAME: Storied Dagger
HegemonMod:StoriedDagger.DESCRIPTION: Apply !M! HegemonMod:Necrotoxin with each attack this turn. NL Deal !D! damage.

HegemonMod:SuitUp.NAME: Suit Up!
HegemonMod:SuitUp.DESCRIPTION: Whenever an unblocked attack deals damage, apply !M! HegemonMod:Necrotoxin.

HegemonMod:Stall.NAME: Stall
HegemonMod:Stall.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Retain. NL Gain !M! Strength while Stalling.

HegemonMod:Stalling.NAME: Stalling
HegemonMod:Stalling.DESCRIPTION: Unplayable. NL Ethereal. NL Apply 2 regen on hit.

HegemonMod:TacticalMap.NAME: Tactical Map
HegemonMod:TacticalMap.DESCRIPTION: On exhausting a card, draw and then discard !M! card.
HegemonMod:TacticalMap.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Innate. NL On exhausting a card, draw and then discard !M! card.

HegemonMod:DoomsHarbinger.NAME: Doom's Harbinger
HegemonMod:DoomsHarbinger.DESCRIPTION: Apply 5 HegemonMod:Leech_Toxin. Target's debuffs are transferred on death. NL Exhaust.
HegemonMod:DoomsHarbinger.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Apply 5 HegemonMod:Leech_Toxin. Target's debuffs are transferred on death.

HegemonMod:Anticipation.NAME: Anticipation
HegemonMod:Anticipation.DESCRIPTION: Lose !HegemonMod:Tax! temporary HP. NL Next turn, gain 2 [E], draw !M! cards. NL Exhaust.
HegemonMod:Anticipation.UPG_DESCRIPTION: Lose !HegemonMod:Tax! temporary HP. NL Next turn, gain 2 [E], draw !M! cards. NL Might Exhaust.

HegemonMod:FeastofBlood.NAME: Feast of Blood
HegemonMod:FeastofBlood.DESCRIPTION: Apply !M! HegemonMod:Leech_Toxin. NL If the target is HegemonMod:Bleeding, remove it and gain !HegemonMod:Regen! Regen.

HegemonMod:Hemorrhage.NAME: Hemorrhage
HegemonMod:Hemorrhage.DESCRIPTION: Apply HegemonMod:Bleeding and !M! HegemonMod:Leech_Toxin. Draw 1 card.

HegemonMod:BloodHarvest.NAME: Blood Harvest
HegemonMod:BloodHarvest.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. If Fatal, heal HP equal to unblocked damage dealt.

HegemonMod:Verdict.NAME: Verdict
HegemonMod:Verdict.DESCRIPTION: Deal damage equal to !M!% of target's lost health.

HegemonMod:Massage.NAME: Massage
HegemonMod:Massage.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage and heal target by !M!. Increase heal by !HegemonMod:Stack! this combat.

HegemonMod:SkillBookTemplate.NAME: %s Skill Book
HegemonMod:SkillBookTemplate.DESCRIPTION: Create a random %s common skill in your hand. NL Exhaust.
HegemonMod:SkillBookTemplate.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Create a random upgraded %s common skill in your hand. NL Exhaust.
